subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a new Rust interactive launcher menu now, or should launcher ergonomics stay in the existing CLI, onboarding, web, and companion-app surfaces until maintainers sponsor that surface?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing startup and build/toolchain surface, so product ownership must be decided before mechanical repair work is worth automating.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
options.body: Keep the direction alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, delegates configured readiness/version behavior, wires build/package support, forwards exact CLI args, and proves real flows.

options.title: Pause or decline core launcher for now
options.body: Close or pause this branch and direct launch ergonomics toward existing onboarding and companion-app work until the surface is explicitly sponsored.

options.title: Accept core launcher ownership
options.body: Own the Rust launcher, packaging, upgrade, and support surface deliberately despite the added toolchain and compatibility responsibilities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
recommendation.body: Keep the direction alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, delegates configured readiness/version behavior, wires build/package support, forwards exact CLI args, and proves real flows.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest available routing owner from recent current-code history around dashboard, Gateway readiness, existing launcher behavior, and Windows launcher/service work.
